title: Arson at Puharich's house
summary: Greg tells of Arson at Puharich's house, about 1978 at Ossining, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Puharich's house burn burned in 1978. Um to this day, no one really knows who did it, but it was a proven, you know, arson job by the the fire department.

plain: A researcher named Greg, on Jesse Michels's podcast about a scientist with ties to the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, who is said to have contacted an alien council, says that this scientist, Puharich, had his house burn down in 1978 in Ossining, New York. Greg says the fire department proved it was arson, but to this day no one really knows who did it. He tells it as a hint that someone may have wanted to stop Puharich's work.
